Implemented Contrastable[S,D], finite signed scalar and five-component outputs, typed compatibility validation, union-preserving keyed rows, explicit canonical Ordering, per-key denominators, both complete source analyses, and typed errors. Added EvaluationSpec metadata and structured provenance; retained geometry checks delegate to Agreement. Public study example now executes through contrast. Updated README, architecture/PRD, contrast contract, parity report, capability map, and development plan.

Verification on local Java 25.0.1: 1,978 test executions passed across the complete JVM/Scala.js module matrix. headerCheckAll, scalafmtCheckAll, scalafmtSbtCheck, githubWorkflowCheck and checkBoundaries passed. The initial testAll invocation exhausted its 1 GB heap while linking lawsJS after preceding modules passed; stopped only that owned process and ran lawsJS, both fs2 and io backends, and boundaries with a 3 GB heap successfully. No code change was needed for heap exhaustion. Hosted Java 17/21 matrix not run.

MatchedControlSuite: 12 tests/backend. ContrastSuite: 29 tests/backend, including 16 published law checks, mismatch/denominator/identity/overflow regressions and compile-time rejection probes. Reversing subtraction caused 12 assertion failures; ignoring parameters caused one. Both mutants restored byte-for-byte before the passing matrix. Pinned R --check reproduced all four generated artifacts. git diff --check and local Markdown links passed.

Logs: /private/tmp/eyes4s-contrast-full-checks.log and /private/tmp/eyes4s-contrast-remaining-checks.log; mutant logs /private/tmp/eyes4s-contrast-mutant-{reverse-subtraction,ignore-parameters}.log; reference /private/tmp/eyes4s-contrast-reference-check.log. Changes remain local and uncommitted. M1 baseline inventory and general fixation-table admission/comparison exports remain open. Next core slice is typed plan/registry/codec persistence of this concrete study.
